name: Shirafuji Angeline Tsubomi
original_name: 白藤・アンジェリーヌ・つぼみ
source:
Grade: High school 1st year student
Ability: FAUX ECLAIR (allows Tsubomi to release electricity from her body)
Precise height: 158.2 cm

A half-Japanese, half-French girl who wears a rabbit hoodie at all times. Tsubomi is a genius at mind, and has a lot of knowledge inside her head, not to mention she loves to create different gadgets. However, her success rate with actually them being succesful is 50-50, and her failed experiments usually explode. Her favorite phrase is "Tsubomi-chan knows everything and anything", which she often repeats.
